mapper.select: select a.id as id, concat(c.name, ' · ', s.name, ' · ', t.name, ' · ', elt(a.day_of_week, '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六', '周日'), ' 第', p1.period_no, '-', p2.period_no, '节') as label from course_arrangement a join course co on a.course_id = co.id join class c on co.class_id = c.id join subject s on co.subject_id = s.id join teacher t on co.teacher_id = t.id join period p1 on a.start_period_id = p1.id join period p2 on a.end_period_id = p2.id order by a.id
